# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target is able to communicate basic ideas in the language of a specific being
(e.g., hungry, thirsty, bathroom, peace, etc.). For the duration of the spell,
the target has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the language.
@@ 3
Creates a 1 foot radius area around the target, into and out of which sound
cannot travel; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with
the object/ being. +25 to any Stalking maneuvers.
@@ 5
Creates a plane (up to 20' x 20'), through which sound will not pass.
@@ 6
As Speech I, except target can communicate in more complex concepts, although
there is a good chance of misinterpretations. For the duration of the spell,
the target has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language.
@@ 7
As Quiet I, except radius is 10'.
@@ 8
As Quiet I, except 3 targets can be affected.
@@ 10
As Soundwall I, except 5 such walls are created. Each Soundwall must be
connected to at least one other Soundwall.
@@ 11
As Quiet I, except 5 targets may be affected.
@@ 13
As Silence I, except radius is 50'.
@@ 15
As Speech II, except target is reasonably fluent in the language. Target’s
accent is imperfect, but there is only a slight chance of misinterpretation.
For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 6
in the language.
@@ 17
Target can speak at 5 times his normal loudness.
@@ 20
As Silence I, except radius is 100'.
@@ 25
As Soundwall V, except as many Soundwalls as the target’s level can be
created.
@@ 30
As Quiet I, except as many targets as the target’s level can be affected.
@@ 50
As Speech III, except for the duration and the target speaks the specified
language as if he were a native. For the duration of the spell, the target has
the equivalent of skill rank 8 in the language.
